identify_affected_packages.expected_solution: PR #116564 (nightly-2024-02-15) changes the representation of static initializers in `rustc_middle` (`compiler/rustc_middle/`): instead of storing them as MIR bodies, they are stored directly in metadata. Source-of-change crate is `rustc_middle` with edits across `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/interpret/error.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/interpret/mod.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/interpret/queries.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/mod.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/pretty.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/query/erase.rs`, `compiler/rustc_middle/src/query/mod.rs`, and `compiler/rustc_middle/src/ty/parameterized.rs`. Affected sibling crates: (1) `rustc_const_eval` (interpreter changes for metadata-based statics, ~17 files), (2) `rustc_metadata` (encode/decode of static initializers), (3) `rustc_mir_transform` (GVN transform), and (4) `miri` (`src/tools/miri/src/shims/intrinsics/mod.rs`).
evaluation_criteria: Must identify rustc_middle as the source-of-change crate with at least one file from compiler/rustc_middle/src/mir/interpret/
Must list all four affected sibling crates: rustc_const_eval, rustc_metadata, rustc_mir_transform, and miri
Must cite compiler/rustc_metadata/src/rmeta/encoder.rs as the metadata encoding change site
Should mention compiler/rustc_const_eval/src/interpret/eval_context.rs or compiler/rustc_const_eval/src/const_eval/eval_queries.rs as the interpreter-side change

classify_change_impact.expected_solution: Overall semver = **minor** for this internal compiler refactor — the visible semantics of static-initializer evaluation are preserved (same const-eval results), but the *implementation pipeline* changes: queries, intrinsics, and metadata layout shift, which is a semver-minor (additive new code paths plus query-result-type tweaks) rather than a behavior break. Per-crate: `rustc_middle` = minor (new error variants, query reshape; no removed public types just internal redirects); `rustc_const_eval` = minor (interpreter knows the new representation, behavior unchanged for valid programs); `rustc_metadata` = minor (encoder/decoder gain a new path; older metadata still readable); `rustc_mir_transform` = minor (GVN updates with the new representation); `miri` = minor (shims updated).
evaluation_criteria: Must classify the overall change as `minor` (additive/internal refactor) and justify with semantics-preserving framing
Must classify rustc_metadata as minor with reasoning that the encoder gains a new path
Must classify rustc_const_eval as minor with reasoning that observable behavior for valid programs is unchanged
Should note that the scope is purely internal compiler plumbing — no nightly-feature surface changes
